items.question: Trong câu "A use case describes a sequence of interactions between a user (actor) and the system to achieve a goal of value.", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A use case describes a sequence of interactions between a user (actor) and the system to achieve a goal of value.", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (danh từ): chuỗi theo thứ tự. "A sequence of steps" = một chuỗi bước theo thứ tự; tính từ liên quan: sequential (tuần tự).
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (noun): a series in order. "A sequence of steps" is a set of steps in a fixed order; related adjective: sequential.

items.question: Trong câu "A use case describes a sequence of interactions between a user (actor) and the system to achieve a goal of value.", từ "interaction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A use case describes a sequence of interactions between a user (actor) and the system to achieve a goal of value.", what does "interaction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interaction /ˌɪn.təˈræk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tương tác. Động từ: interact with (tương tác với); use case mô tả tương tác giữa actor và hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: interaction /ˌɪn.təˈræk.ʃən/ (noun): a two-way exchange. Verb: interact with; a use case describes the interactions between an actor and the system.

items.question: Trong câu "A use case describes a sequence of interactions between a user (actor) and the system to achieve a goal of value.", từ "achieve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A use case describes a sequence of interactions between a user (actor) and the system to achieve a goal of value.", what does "achieve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: achieve /əˈtʃiːv/ (động từ): đạt được. Collocation hay gặp: achieve a goal / a result / a target (đạt mục tiêu / kết quả).
items.explanationEn: achieve /əˈtʃiːv/ (verb): to reach successfully. Common collocations: achieve a goal, a result, a target.

items.question: Trong câu "The key point: a use case is always written from the actor's perspective and always targets a complete goal, not an isolated action.", từ "perspective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key point: a use case is always written from the actor's perspective and always targets a complete goal, not an isolated action.", what does "perspective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: perspective /pərˈspek.tɪv/ (danh từ): góc nhìn. "From the user's perspective" = từ góc nhìn của người dùng; trong hội họa, perspective là phối cảnh.
items.explanationEn: perspective /pərˈspek.tɪv/ (noun): a point of view. "From the user's perspective" means seen through the user's eyes; in art, perspective means depth in a drawing.

items.question: Trong câu "The key point: a use case is always written from the actor's perspective and always targets a complete goal, not an isolated action.", từ "target" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key point: a use case is always written from the actor's perspective and always targets a complete goal, not an isolated action.", what does "target" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: target /ˈtɑːr.ɡɪt/ (động từ): nhắm tới. Danh từ target = mục tiêu; "target users" = người dùng mục tiêu.
items.explanationEn: target /ˈtɑːr.ɡɪt/ (verb): to aim at. As a noun, target means a goal; "target users" are the intended users.

items.question: Trong câu "The key point: a use case is always written from the actor's perspective and always targets a complete goal, not an isolated action.", từ "isolated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key point: a use case is always written from the actor's perspective and always targets a complete goal, not an isolated action.", what does "isolated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: isolated /ˈaɪ.sə.leɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): riêng lẻ. "An isolated action" = một hành động đơn lẻ, không gắn với mục tiêu hoàn chỉnh; "an isolated case" = trường hợp cá biệt.
items.explanationEn: isolated /ˈaɪ.sə.leɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): standing alone. "An isolated action" stands alone without a complete goal; "an isolated case" is a one-off.

items.question: Trong câu "The team sits together and talks constantly", từ "constantly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team sits together and talks constantly", what does "constantly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: constantly /ˈkɑːn.stənt.li/ (trạng từ): liên tục. Đồng nghĩa: continually, all the time; tính từ: constant (không đổi, liên tục).
items.explanationEn: constantly /ˈkɑːn.stənt.li/ (adverb): all the time. Synonyms: continually, all the time; adjective: constant.

items.question: Trong câu "This is not an either-or choice.", từ "either-or" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is not an either-or choice.", what does "either-or" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: either-or /ˈiː.ðər ɔːr/ (tính từ): chỉ chọn một. "Not an either-or choice" = không phải chọn cái này thì bỏ cái kia; có thể dùng cả hai.
items.explanationEn: either-or /ˈiː.ðər ɔːr/ (adjective): one or the other. "Not an either-or choice" means you can use both instead of picking one.

items.question: Trong câu "Many teams use stories to prioritize and plan, then write use case specifications for the most complex flows — where one sentence on a card is not enough.", từ "prioritize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many teams use stories to prioritize and plan, then write use case specifications for the most complex flows — where one sentence on a card is not enough.", what does "prioritize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prioritize /praɪˈɔːr.ə.taɪz/ (động từ): sắp xếp ưu tiên. Danh từ: priority (ưu tiên), prioritization; "prioritize the backlog" = sắp ưu tiên backlog.
items.explanationEn: prioritize /praɪˈɔːr.ə.taɪz/ (verb): to rank by importance. Nouns: priority, prioritization; "prioritize the backlog" means ordering it by importance.

items.question: Trong câu "Many teams use stories to prioritize and plan, then write use case specifications for the most complex flows — where one sentence on a card is not enough.", từ "specification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many teams use stories to prioritize and plan, then write use case specifications for the most complex flows — where one sentence on a card is not enough.", what does "specification" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: specification /ˌspes.ə.fəˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): bản đặc tả. Viết tắt thường gặp: spec; động từ: specify (nêu rõ).
items.explanationEn: specification /ˌspes.ə.fəˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a detailed description. Often shortened to spec; verb: specify.

items.question: Trong câu "Use a use case when: the flow has many branches and exceptions, several actors participate, documentation is needed for a contract or certification, or the team is too distributed to rely on conversation.", từ "participate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use a use case when: the flow has many branches and exceptions, several actors participate, documentation is needed for a contract or certification, or the team is too distributed to rely on conversation.", what does "participate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: participate /pɑːrˈtɪs.ə.peɪt/ (động từ): tham gia. Cấu trúc: participate in something; danh từ: participant (người tham gia).
items.explanationEn: participate /pɑːrˈtɪs.ə.peɪt/ (verb): to take part. Pattern: participate in something; noun: participant.

items.question: Trong câu "Use a use case when: the flow has many branches and exceptions, several actors participate, documentation is needed for a contract or certification, or the team is too distributed to rely on conversation.", từ "certification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use a use case when: the flow has many branches and exceptions, several actors participate, documentation is needed for a contract or certification, or the team is too distributed to rely on conversation.", what does "certification" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: certification /ˌsɝː.t̬ə.fəˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự chứng nhận. Hệ thống cần chứng nhận (ví dụ ISO) thường đòi hỏi tài liệu đầy đủ; động từ: certify.
items.explanationEn: certification /ˌsɝː.t̬ə.fəˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): official approval. Systems seeking certification (e.g. ISO) usually need full documentation; verb: certify.

items.question: Trong câu "Use a use case when: the flow has many branches and exceptions, several actors participate, documentation is needed for a contract or certification, or the team is too distributed to rely on conversation.", từ "distributed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use a use case when: the flow has many branches and exceptions, several actors participate, documentation is needed for a contract or certification, or the team is too distributed to rely on conversation.", what does "distributed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distributed /dɪˈstrɪb.juː.tɪd/ (tính từ): phân tán nhiều nơi. "A distributed team" = đội làm việc ở nhiều địa điểm/múi giờ; nghĩa khác của distribute là phân phát.
items.explanationEn: distributed /dɪˈstrɪb.juː.tɪd/ (adjective): spread across places. "A distributed team" works across locations or time zones; distribute also means to hand out.

items.question: Trong câu "Use a use case when: the flow has many branches and exceptions, several actors participate, documentation is needed for a contract or certification, or the team is too distributed to rely on conversation.", từ "rely on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use a use case when: the flow has many branches and exceptions, several actors participate, documentation is needed for a contract or certification, or the team is too distributed to rely on conversation.", what does "rely on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɑːn/ (cụm từ): dựa vào. Tính từ: reliable (đáng tin cậy); danh từ: reliance.
items.explanationEn: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɑːn/ (phrase): to depend on. Adjective: reliable; noun: reliance.

items.question: Trong câu "There is no single standard template, but these fields appear in almost all of them:", từ "template" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is no single standard template, but these fields appear in almost all of them:", what does "template" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: template /ˈtem.plət/ (danh từ): biểu mẫu. "A standard template" = một mẫu chuẩn; đừng nhầm với temple (đền).
items.explanationEn: template /ˈtem.plət/ (noun): a reusable pattern. "A standard template" is a reusable pattern; do not confuse it with temple.

items.question: Trong câu "There is no single standard template, but these fields appear in almost all of them:", từ "field" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is no single standard template, but these fields appear in almost all of them:", what does "field" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: field /fiːld/ (danh từ): mục thông tin. Trong tài liệu và biểu mẫu, field là một mục cần điền; "in the field of IT" lại là lĩnh vực.
items.explanationEn: field /fiːld/ (noun): an item of data. In forms and documents a field is an item to fill in; "in the field of IT" means area of work.

items.question: Trong câu "Who initiates it and receives the value", từ "initiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who initiates it and receives the value", what does "initiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: initiate /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.eɪt/ (động từ): khởi xướng. Primary actor là người khởi xướng use case; danh từ: initiative (sáng kiến).
items.explanationEn: initiate /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.eɪt/ (verb): to start. The primary actor initiates the use case; noun: initiative.

items.question: Trong câu "Systems or people who assist", từ "assist" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Systems or people who assist", what does "assist" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assist /əˈsɪst/ (động từ): hỗ trợ. Danh từ: assistance, assistant (trợ lý); secondary actor hỗ trợ use case.
items.explanationEn: assist /əˈsɪst/ (verb): to help. Nouns: assistance, assistant; secondary actors assist the use case.

items.question: Trong câu "The system state after successful completion", từ "completion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The system state after successful completion", what does "completion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: completion /kəmˈpliː.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự hoàn thành. "Upon completion" = khi hoàn thành; động từ: complete.
items.explanationEn: completion /kəmˈpliː.ʃən/ (noun): finishing. "Upon completion" means once finished; verb: complete.

items.question: Trong câu "Other routes that also reach success", từ "route" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other routes that also reach success", what does "route" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: route /ruːt/ (danh từ): cách để đạt tới. Alternative flow là "lối khác" dẫn tới thành công; route cũng có nghĩa tuyến đường giao thông cố định.
items.explanationEn: route /ruːt/ (noun): a way. An alternative flow is another route to success; route also means a fixed transport line.

items.question: Trong câu "The two most-omitted fields are preconditions and postconditions.", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The two most-omitted fields are preconditions and postconditions.", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /oʊˈmɪt/ (động từ): bỏ sót. Danh từ: omission (sự bỏ sót); "most-omitted" = hay bị bỏ sót nhất.
items.explanationEn: omit /oʊˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. Noun: omission; "most-omitted" means most often left out.

items.question: Trong câu "Without them, developers do not know what state the use case starts and ends in — the source of many integration defects between screens.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without them, developers do not know what state the use case starts and ends in — the source of many integration defects between screens.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (danh từ): lỗi. Trong kiểm thử, defect ≈ bug; "defect report" = báo cáo lỗi. Động từ defect (/dɪˈfekt/) nghĩa là đào tẩu.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (noun): a fault. In testing, defect is close to bug; "defect report". The verb defect means to desert.

items.question: Trong câu "Without them, developers do not know what state the use case starts and ends in — the source of many integration defects between screens.", từ "integration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without them, developers do not know what state the use case starts and ends in — the source of many integration defects between screens.", what does "integration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: integration /ˌɪn.t̬əˈɡreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tích hợp. "Integration defects" = lỗi phát sinh khi ghép các màn hình/hệ thống lại với nhau.
items.explanationEn: integration /ˌɪn.t̬əˈɡreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): joining parts together. "Integration defects" appear when screens or systems are joined together.

items.question: Trong câu "The sequence when everything goes well.", từ "go well" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The sequence when everything goes well.", what does "go well" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: go well /ɡoʊ wel/ (cụm từ): suôn sẻ. Normal flow là kịch bản "mọi thứ suôn sẻ" (happy path).
items.explanationEn: go well /ɡoʊ wel/ (phrase): to happen smoothly. The normal flow is the case where everything goes well, the happy path.

items.question: Trong câu "Write it in pairs: actor action → system response.", từ "pair" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write it in pairs: actor action → system response.", what does "pair" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pair /per/ (danh từ): cặp. "In pairs" = theo từng cặp; "pair programming" = lập trình cặp.
items.explanationEn: pair /per/ (noun): a set of two. "In pairs" means two at a time; "pair programming" is coding in twos.

items.question: Trong câu "Write it in pairs: actor action → system response.", từ "response" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write it in pairs: actor action → system response.", what does "response" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: response /rɪˈspɑːns/ (danh từ): sự phản hồi. Động từ: respond (to); "response time" = thời gian phản hồi.
items.explanationEn: response /rɪˈspɑːns/ (noun): a reply. Verb: respond (to); "response time" is how quickly a system answers.

items.question: Trong câu "The requester enters the chemical name and quantity.", từ "quantity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The requester enters the chemical name and quantity.", what does "quantity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: quantity /ˈkwɑːn.t̬ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): số lượng. Phân biệt quantity (số lượng) với quality (chất lượng).
items.explanationEn: quantity /ˈkwɑːn.t̬ə.t̬i/ (noun): an amount. Distinguish quantity (how much) from quality (how good).

items.question: Trong câu "The system searches the stockroom and the vendor catalogs.", từ "vendor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The system searches the stockroom and the vendor catalogs.", what does "vendor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: vendor /ˈven.dɚ/ (danh từ): nhà cung cấp. "Vendor catalog" = danh mục hàng của nhà cung cấp; đồng nghĩa: supplier.
items.explanationEn: vendor /ˈven.dɚ/ (noun): a seller. "Vendor catalog" is a seller's product list; synonym: supplier.

items.question: Trong câu "The system displays available options with estimated delivery times.", từ "estimated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The system displays available options with estimated delivery times.", what does "estimated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: estimated /ˈes.tə.meɪ.t̬ɪd/ (tính từ): ước tính. "Estimated delivery time" = thời gian giao hàng dự kiến; động từ: estimate.
items.explanationEn: estimated /ˈes.tə.meɪ.t̬ɪd/ (adjective): approximate. "Estimated delivery time" is the expected time; verb: estimate.

items.question: Trong câu "The requester selects an option and confirms.", từ "confirm" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The requester selects an option and confirms.", what does "confirm" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: confirm /kənˈfɝːm/ (động từ): xác nhận. Danh từ: confirmation; "confirm an order" = xác nhận đơn.
items.explanationEn: confirm /kənˈfɝːm/ (verb): to verify. Noun: confirmation; "confirm an order".

items.question: Trong câu "The system creates the request in Pending Approval status and notifies the approver.", từ "notify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The system creates the request in Pending Approval status and notifies the approver.", what does "notify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: notify /ˈnoʊ.t̬ə.faɪ/ (động từ): thông báo. Cấu trúc: notify someone of something; danh từ: notification.
items.explanationEn: notify /ˈnoʊ.t̬ə.faɪ/ (verb): to inform. Pattern: notify someone of something; noun: notification.

items.question: Trong câu "Number every step so other flows can reference them.", từ "reference" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Number every step so other flows can reference them.", what does "reference" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reference /ˈref.ɚ.əns/ (động từ): dẫn chiếu tới. Đánh số bước để các luồng khác tham chiếu; danh từ reference còn là người giới thiệu (xin việc).
items.explanationEn: reference /ˈref.ɚ.əns/ (verb): to point to. Numbering lets other flows reference steps; as a noun it also means a job referee.

items.question: Trong câu "One action per step, never merged.", từ "merge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One action per step, never merged.", what does "merge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: merge /mɝːdʒ/ (động từ): gộp lại. "Merge two steps" = gộp hai bước; danh từ merger = sáp nhập (công ty).
items.explanationEn: merge /mɝːdʒ/ (verb): to combine. "Merge two steps" means combining them; merger means a company combination.

items.question: Trong câu "State which step they branch from and where they rejoin.", từ "rejoin" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State which step they branch from and where they rejoin.", what does "rejoin" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rejoin /riːˈdʒɔɪn/ (động từ): nhập lại. Luồng thay thế tách từ một bước và nhập lại luồng chính ở bước khác.
items.explanationEn: rejoin /riːˈdʒɔɪn/ (verb): to reunite. An alternative flow branches off and rejoins the main flow later.

items.question: Trong câu "State which step they branch from and where they rejoin.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State which step they branch from and where they rejoin.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu rõ. Danh từ state = trạng thái hoặc bang/nhà nước; động từ state = nêu rõ. Danh từ: statement.
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. As a noun, state means condition or nation; the verb means to say clearly. Noun: statement.

items.question: Trong câu "The system reports it was not found and offers to raise a special request.", từ "raise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The system reports it was not found and offers to raise a special request.", what does "raise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: raise /reɪz/ (động từ): đưa ra. Collocation công sở: raise a request / an issue / a concern (nêu yêu cầu, vấn đề, lo ngại).
items.explanationEn: raise /reɪz/ (verb): to put forward. Workplace collocations: raise a request, an issue, a concern.

items.question: Trong câu "The notification service is unreachable", từ "unreachable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The notification service is unreachable", what does "unreachable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unreachable /ʌnˈriː.tʃə.bəl/ (tính từ): không liên lạc được. Dùng khi dịch vụ hoặc máy chủ không phản hồi; ngược nghĩa: reachable.
items.explanationEn: unreachable /ʌnˈriː.tʃə.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to contact. Used when a service or server cannot be contacted; opposite: reachable.

items.question: Trong câu "The system retries the notification after 5 minutes.", từ "retry" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The system retries the notification after 5 minutes.", what does "retry" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: retry /ˌriːˈtraɪ/ (động từ): thử lại. Cơ chế "retry" thường có giới hạn số lần; đừng nhầm với retire (nghỉ hưu).
items.explanationEn: retry /ˌriːˈtraɪ/ (verb): to try again. Retries usually have a maximum count; do not confuse with retire.

items.question: Trong câu "It lets you reference precisely in documents, test cases, and defect reports.", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It lets you reference precisely in documents, test cases, and defect reports.", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (trạng từ): chính xác. Tính từ: precise; danh từ: precision (độ chính xác).
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (adverb): exactly. Adjective: precise; noun: precision.

items.question: Trong câu "An actor is anyone or any system that interacts with the system under discussion from outside it.", từ "under discussion" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An actor is anyone or any system that interacts with the system under discussion from outside it.", what does "under discussion" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: under discussion /ˈʌn.dɚ dɪˈskʌʃ.ən/ (cụm từ): đang được bàn tới. "The system under discussion" = hệ thống đang được phân tích; cụm tương tự: under review, under consideration.
items.explanationEn: under discussion /ˈʌn.dɚ dɪˈskʌʃ.ən/ (phrase): being talked about. "The system under discussion" is the one being analysed; similar: under review, under consideration.

items.question: Trong câu "Users — classified by role, not job title.", từ "classify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users — classified by role, not job title.", what does "classify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: classify /ˈklæs.ə.faɪ/ (động từ): phân loại. Nghĩa khác: classified document = tài liệu mật. Danh từ: classification.
items.explanationEn: classify /ˈklæs.ə.faɪ/ (verb): to sort into groups. Another sense: a classified document is secret. Noun: classification.

items.question: Trong câu "External systems — payment gateways, HR systems, email services.", từ "external" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "External systems — payment gateways, HR systems, email services.", what does "external" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: external /ɪkˈstɝː.nəl/ (tính từ): bên ngoài. Trái nghĩa: internal (nội bộ); external system = hệ thống bên ngoài cần tích hợp.
items.explanationEn: external /ɪkˈstɝː.nəl/ (adjective): outside. Opposite: internal; an external system sits outside and must be integrated.

items.question: Trong câu "External systems — payment gateways, HR systems, email services.", từ "gateway" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "External systems — payment gateways, HR systems, email services.", what does "gateway" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gateway /ˈɡeɪt.weɪ/ (danh từ): cổng dịch vụ. "Payment gateway" = cổng thanh toán; nghĩa đen gateway là cổng ra vào.
items.explanationEn: gateway /ˈɡeɪt.weɪ/ (noun): a connecting service. "Payment gateway" is a service that processes payments; literally, a gateway is an entrance.

items.question: Trong câu "Time — for scheduled use cases, the actor is a timer.", từ "scheduled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Time — for scheduled use cases, the actor is a timer.", what does "scheduled" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: scheduled /ˈskedʒ.uːld/ (tính từ): theo lịch. "Scheduled job" = tác vụ chạy theo lịch; "ahead of schedule" = sớm hơn kế hoạch.
items.explanationEn: scheduled /ˈskedʒ.uːld/ (adjective): planned. A "scheduled job" runs at planned times; "ahead of schedule" means early.

items.question: Trong câu "Confusing an actor with a specific person.", từ "confuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Confusing an actor with a specific person.", what does "confuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (động từ): nhầm lẫn. Cấu trúc: confuse A with B (nhầm A với B); tính từ: confusing, confused.
items.explanationEn: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (verb): to mix up. Pattern: confuse A with B; adjectives: confusing, confused.

items.question: Trong câu "Many use cases involve an external system that is never written down, leading to missed integration requirements.", từ "involve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many use cases involve an external system that is never written down, leading to missed integration requirements.", what does "involve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: involve /ɪnˈvɑːlv/ (động từ): bao gồm. Danh từ: involvement; "be involved in" = tham gia vào.
items.explanationEn: involve /ɪnˈvɑːlv/ (verb): to include. Noun: involvement; "be involved in" means to take part in.

items.question: Trong câu "Many use cases involve an external system that is never written down, leading to missed integration requirements.", từ "lead to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many use cases involve an external system that is never written down, leading to missed integration requirements.", what does "lead to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: lead to /liːd tuː/ (cụm từ): dẫn đến. "Lead to problems / delays" = gây ra vấn đề / chậm trễ.
items.explanationEn: lead to /liːd tuː/ (phrase): to result in. "Lead to problems or delays" means cause them.

items.question: Trong câu "Writing at the action level rather than the goal level.", từ "rather than" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Writing at the action level rather than the goal level.", what does "rather than" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rather than /ˈræð.ɚ ðæn/ (cụm từ): thay vì. Cấu trúc song song: A rather than B; nhấn mạnh lựa chọn A.
items.explanationEn: rather than /ˈræð.ɚ ðæn/ (phrase): instead of. Parallel pattern: A rather than B, choosing A.

items.question: Trong câu "locks the design and makes the document stale the moment the interface changes.", từ "lock" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "locks the design and makes the document stale the moment the interface changes.", what does "lock" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lock /lɑːk/ (động từ): cố định lại. "Lock the design" = đóng khung thiết kế, không còn linh hoạt; "lock in" = chốt lại.
items.explanationEn: lock /lɑːk/ (verb): to fix in place. "Lock the design" fixes it so it cannot change; "lock in" means to secure.

items.question: Trong câu "locks the design and makes the document stale the moment the interface changes.", từ "stale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "locks the design and makes the document stale the moment the interface changes.", what does "stale" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stale /steɪl/ (tính từ): lỗi thời. Nghĩa gốc: bánh mì cũ, ôi; trong phần mềm "stale data" = dữ liệu cũ, lỗi thời.
items.explanationEn: stale /steɪl/ (adjective): out of date. Literal sense: old bread; in software "stale data" is outdated data.

items.question: Trong câu "locks the design and makes the document stale the moment the interface changes.", từ "the moment" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "locks the design and makes the document stale the moment the interface changes.", what does "the moment" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: the moment /ðə ˈmoʊ.mənt/ (cụm từ): ngay khi. "The moment + mệnh đề" = ngay khi điều gì xảy ra; đồng nghĩa: as soon as.
items.explanationEn: the moment /ðə ˈmoʊ.mənt/ (phrase): as soon as. "The moment + clause" means as soon as something happens.

items.question: Trong câu "Most of the complexity and most of the defects live in the exception flows.", từ "complexity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most of the complexity and most of the defects live in the exception flows.", what does "complexity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: complexity /kəmˈplek.sə.t̬i/ (danh từ): độ phức tạp. Tính từ: complex; "reduce complexity" = giảm độ phức tạp.
items.explanationEn: complexity /kəmˈplek.sə.t̬i/ (noun): complicatedness. Adjective: complex; "reduce complexity".

items.question: Trong câu "If they must come back with many questions, it is not yet sufficient.", từ "sufficient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If they must come back with many questions, it is not yet sufficient.", what does "sufficient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sufficient /səˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (tính từ): đủ. Trái nghĩa: insufficient; "sufficient detail" = đủ chi tiết.
items.explanationEn: sufficient /səˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (adjective): enough. Opposite: insufficient; "sufficient detail".

items.question: Trong câu "If they must come back with many questions, it is not yet sufficient.", từ "come back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If they must come back with many questions, it is not yet sufficient.", what does "come back" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: come back /kʌm bæk/ (cụm từ): quay lại hỏi. "Come back to someone with questions" = quay lại hỏi thêm; "comeback" = sự trở lại.
items.explanationEn: come back /kʌm bæk/ (phrase): to return to ask. "Come back with questions" means return to ask more; "comeback" is a return to success.

items.question: Trong câu "These serve different purposes and do not replace each other.", từ "purpose" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: purpose /ˈpɝː.pəs/ (danh từ): mục đích. "Serve a purpose" = phục vụ một mục đích; "on purpose" = cố ý.
items.explanationEn: purpose /ˈpɝː.pəs/ (noun): an aim. "Serve a purpose" means to be useful for something; "on purpose" means deliberately.

items.question: Trong câu "A use case diagram gives a high-level scope picture: which actor uses which capability.", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A use case diagram gives a high-level scope picture: which actor uses which capability.", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skoʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi. "In scope / out of scope" = trong / ngoài phạm vi; "scope creep" = phạm vi phình ra.
items.explanationEn: scope /skoʊp/ (noun): extent covered. "In scope / out of scope"; "scope creep" is uncontrolled growth of scope.

items.question: Trong câu "A use case diagram gives a high-level scope picture: which actor uses which capability.", từ "capability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A use case diagram gives a high-level scope picture: which actor uses which capability.", what does "capability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): năng lực. Tính từ: capable of; đừng nhầm với capacity (sức chứa).
items.explanationEn: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (noun): an ability. Adjective: capable of; do not confuse with capacity.

items.question: Trong câu "A use case diagram gives a high-level scope picture: which actor uses which capability.", từ "high-level" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A use case diagram gives a high-level scope picture: which actor uses which capability.", what does "high-level" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: high-level /ˌhaɪˈlev.əl/ (tính từ): tổng quan. "High-level overview" = cái nhìn tổng quan; nghĩa khác: high-level meeting = cuộc họp cấp cao.
items.explanationEn: high-level /ˌhaɪˈlev.əl/ (adjective): broad. "High-level overview" is a broad summary; a high-level meeting involves senior people.

items.question: Trong câu "That is what developers and testers actually work from.", từ "work from" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is what developers and testers actually work from.", what does "work from" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: work from /wɝːk frʌm/ (cụm từ): làm dựa trên. "Work from a specification" = làm việc dựa trên đặc tả; khác "work from home" = làm tại nhà.
items.explanationEn: work from /wɝːk frʌm/ (phrase): to base work on. "Work from a specification" means using it as the basis; unlike "work from home".

items.question: Trong câu "A common mistake: drawing the diagram and considering the specification complete.", từ "consider" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common mistake: drawing the diagram and considering the specification complete.", what does "consider" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consider /kənˈsɪd.ɚ/ (động từ): coi là. "Consider something complete" = coi một thứ là đã xong; nghĩa khác: consider an option = cân nhắc một lựa chọn.
items.explanationEn: consider /kənˈsɪd.ɚ/ (verb): to regard as. "Consider something complete" means to regard it as done; "consider an option" means to think about it.

items.question: Trong câu "The diagram is a table of contents; the content lives in the specification.", từ "table of contents" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The diagram is a table of contents; the content lives in the specification.", what does "table of contents" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: table of contents /ˈteɪ.bəl əv ˈkɑːn.tents/ (cụm từ): mục lục. Sơ đồ use case chỉ là "mục lục", còn nội dung nằm trong đặc tả.
items.explanationEn: table of contents /ˈteɪ.bəl əv ˈkɑːn.tents/ (phrase): a list of sections. The use case diagram is only the table of contents; the substance is in the specification.

items.question: Trong câu "Association — an actor participates in a use case (a plain line).", từ "plain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Association — an actor participates in a use case (a plain line).", what does "plain" (adjective) mean?

items.explanationEn: plain /pleɪn/ (adjective): undecorated. "A plain line" has no arrowheads; "plain English" is simple, clear language.

items.question: Trong câu "Include — use case A always invokes B as a mandatory part.", từ "invoke" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Include — use case A always invokes B as a mandatory part.", what does "invoke" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: invoke /ɪnˈvoʊk/ (động từ): gọi thực thi. Trong phần mềm: invoke a function / service = gọi hàm / dịch vụ.
items.explanationEn: invoke /ɪnˈvoʊk/ (verb): to call and run. In software: invoke a function or service means to call it.

items.question: Trong câu "Include — use case A always invokes B as a mandatory part.", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Include — use case A always invokes B as a mandatory part.", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tɔːr.i/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. Đồng nghĩa: compulsory, required; trái nghĩa: optional.
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tɔːr.i/ (adjective): required. Synonyms: compulsory, required; opposite: optional.

items.question: Trong câu "Extend — use case B adds behaviour to A under a certain condition.", từ "behaviour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Extend — use case B adds behaviour to A under a certain condition.", what does "behaviour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: behaviour /bɪˈheɪ.vjɚ/ (danh từ): cách hoạt động. Anh-Anh: behaviour, Anh-Mỹ: behavior; "system behaviour" = cách hệ thống phản ứng.
items.explanationEn: behaviour /bɪˈheɪ.vjɚ/ (noun): the way it acts. British behaviour, American behavior; "system behaviour" is how the system acts.

items.question: Trong câu "Practical advice: do not overuse include and extend.", từ "overuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practical advice: do not overuse include and extend.", what does "overuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overuse /ˌoʊ.vɚˈjuːz/ (động từ): lạm dụng. Tiền tố over- = quá mức: overuse, overload, over-invest.
items.explanationEn: overuse /ˌoʊ.vɚˈjuːz/ (verb): to use too much. Prefix over- means too much: overuse, overload, over-invest.

items.question: Trong câu "Practical advice: do not overuse include and extend.", từ "practical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practical advice: do not overuse include and extend.", what does "practical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: practical /ˈpræk.tɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): thiết thực. "Practical advice" = lời khuyên thực tế; trạng từ practically còn có nghĩa "gần như".
items.explanationEn: practical /ˈpræk.tɪ.kəl/ (adjective): useful in practice. "Practical advice" is useful in real work; the adverb practically can also mean almost.

items.question: Trong câu "They invite argument and add little for non-specialist readers.", từ "invite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They invite argument and add little for non-specialist readers.", what does "invite" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: invite /ɪnˈvaɪt/ (động từ): chuốc lấy. "Invite argument / criticism" = dễ gây tranh cãi / chỉ trích; nghĩa thường gặp là mời.
items.explanationEn: invite /ɪnˈvaɪt/ (verb): to provoke. "Invite argument or criticism" means to provoke it; the usual sense is to ask someone to come.

items.question: Trong câu "If the diagram becomes hard to follow because of them, simplify it.", từ "simplify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the diagram becomes hard to follow because of them, simplify it.", what does "simplify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: simplify /ˈsɪm.plə.faɪ/ (động từ): đơn giản hóa. Danh từ: simplification; "hard to follow" = khó theo dõi.
items.explanationEn: simplify /ˈsɪm.plə.faɪ/ (verb): to make simpler. Noun: simplification; "hard to follow" means difficult to understand.

items.question: Trong câu "Never describe the interface in the flow — it locks the design and dates the document instantly.", từ "instantly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Never describe the interface in the flow — it locks the design and dates the document instantly.", what does "instantly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: instantly /ˈɪn.stənt.li/ (trạng từ): ngay lập tức. Tính từ: instant; "instant messaging" = nhắn tin tức thì.
items.explanationEn: instantly /ˈɪn.stənt.li/ (adverb): immediately. Adjective: instant; "instant messaging".

items.question: Trong câu "Diagrams give scope, specifications give detail — they complement rather than replace each other.", từ "complement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Diagrams give scope, specifications give detail — they complement rather than replace each other.", what does "complement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: complement /ˈkɑːm.plə.ment/ (động từ): bổ sung. Đừng nhầm complement (bổ sung) với compliment (khen ngợi); tính từ: complementary.
items.explanationEn: complement /ˈkɑːm.plə.ment/ (verb): to go well with. Do not confuse complement with compliment (praise); adjective: complementary.

items.question: Trong câu "Use a use case when many branches, many actors, contractual documentation, or a distributed team.", từ "contractual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use a use case when many branches, many actors, contractual documentation, or a distributed team.", what does "contractual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contractual /kənˈtræk.tʃu.əl/ (tính từ): theo hợp đồng. "Contractual obligation" = nghĩa vụ theo hợp đồng.
items.explanationEn: contractual /kənˈtræk.tʃu.əl/ (adjective): under a contract. "Contractual obligation" is a duty under a contract.

items.question: Trong câu "The convention 4a means the first branch off step 4, enabling precise references.", từ "enable" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The convention 4a means the first branch off step 4, enabling precise references.", what does "enable" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enable /ɪˈneɪ.bəl/ (động từ): giúp có thể. Cấu trúc: enable someone to do something; trong phần mềm "enable a setting" = bật một thiết lập.
items.explanationEn: enable /ɪˈneɪ.bəl/ (verb): to make possible. Pattern: enable someone to do something; in software, "enable a setting" means to switch it on.

items.question: Trong câu "The diagram is the table of contents; the specification is the content — drawing one is not specifying.", từ "specify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The diagram is the table of contents; the specification is the content — drawing one is not specifying.", what does "specify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: specify /ˈspes.ə.faɪ/ (động từ): nêu chi tiết. Danh từ: specification; tính từ: specific (cụ thể).
items.explanationEn: specify /ˈspes.ə.faɪ/ (verb): to detail. Noun: specification; adjective: specific.
